_meta.description: Commits that changed a page's SOURCES without changing what any built page says. scripts/generate_page_dates.py skips each commit for the source paths it names when it dates a route, so a refactor never stamps a false dateModified on the pages it did not change (working rule 9). A commit is listed only after the built pages it touched were diffed against the build before it. Never list a commit that changed a page's words, facts or images.
_meta.floor_override: Optional. route -> {datePublished, reason}. The publication floor is one-way (no run moves a route's datePublished later than any committed map gave it); a date an old map got WRONG is corrected here, with its reason, never by rewriting history.
_meta.fanout_accepted: Optional. [{sha, reason}]: a commit that moves dateModified on 3 or more routes because every one of those pages really changed. Without an entry here or in `commits`, such a commit stops the date step (the fan-out guard, Task 8b).
